newsitem.title: SWEDEN: TI says will not raise Forsheda bid.
newsitem.headline: TI says will not raise Forsheda bid.

text.p: Britain's TI group said on Monday it had no plans to raise its per share offer in its ongoing bid for Swedish polymer maker Forsheda.
TI has bid 225 crowns per B-series share and 247.50 crowns per A-series share with the aim of acquiring all outstanding shares in Forsheda.

"After the publication of Forsheda's results for the third quarter on October 26, the board of TI, to which SBC Warburg acts as adviser, has concluded that its offer fully reflects the value of Forsheda's A and B series shares," it said.
TI said it had received firm offers to accept the shares from shareholders corresponding to 63.6 percent of the votes and 20.6 percent of the total number of shares in Forsheda.

"TI already has the right to acquire shares giving a vote majority in Forsheda. In accordance with the terms of the offer, TI has the right to fulfil the offer even if it does not achieve 90 percent (of the votes)," it said.
